title: Host console log: keep the call site in lock-timing kinds and flush pending summaries at shutdown
outcome: The host console's rate limiter no longer hides a severe stall behind a minor one: lock-timing kinds include the call site, or a much longer hold than the one printed is never suppressed. Named-root reclamation outcomes other than deferred are not merged into one kind. Pending suppressed-line summaries are flushed when the host shuts down, and each summary names the end of its window.
acceptance: Host console log: keep the call site in lock-timing kinds and flush pending summaries at shutdown is done
